# ada-url / url_search_params

ada-url's own fuzz target `url_search_params` ([source](source/url_search_params.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over ada (ada-url/ada at e6754478).

Checks 2 properties (listed below); the first, an idempotence law: application/x-www-form-urlencoded serialisation is a fixed point: url_search_params(s).to_string() == s for s = to_string() of (a) params built from fuzz input, (b) params after append/set/remove/sort/reset/copy/move, and (c) params taken from a URL whose query is the fuzz input.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against ada at commit e6754478.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- application/x-www-form-urlencoded serialisation is a fixed point: url_search_params(s).to_string() == s for s = to_string() of (a) params built from fuzz input, (b) params after append/set/remove/sort/reset/copy/move, and (c) params taken from a URL whose query is the fuzz input ([lines 224-289](source/url_search_params.cc#L224-L289)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.
